author: User:CryptoDerk
viewpoint_description: Wide view of MC from an open sloping lawn: two facades meeting at a corner, central fluted stair/service towers, pilotis ground floor; delivery truck at loading area. Exact compass side not stated by uploader (likely north/east from MC green).

author: BradBeattie at English Wikipedia
viewpoint_description: Upper floors of MC with window-hood bands and stepped stair towers, low golden sun (colour warmer than real); bare trees in front.

author: Giligone
viewpoint_description: 360-ish stitched panorama from MC Green: MC at centre with flower bed and path fork; pergola/brick buildings at left; long 3-storey brown-brick building at right (identity uncertain).

author: Sampsonchen
viewpoint_description: MC long facade seen across a mown lawn with a worn desire path; horse-chestnut/maple trees and a spruce; Commons title calls it the MC-DC courtyard. Date field 2013-03-09 is upload/EXIF; foliage indicates late spring (category says 2012).

author: Sampsonchen
viewpoint_description: Upward detail at MC ground level: precast piers, cantilevered underside, fluted precast spandrels, brown brick infill, dark window frames, window-hood band above.

author: Sampsonchen
viewpoint_description: Upward view of two MC stair/service towers showing vertically fluted (ribbed) concrete finish.

author: Sampsonchen
viewpoint_description: MC seen across a snow-covered lawn in winter; QNC glass bar with rooftop exhaust stacks visible to the right behind spruces.

author: Saforrest
viewpoint_description: MC stair tower on the west side (geotag 43.47173,-80.54448, facing SLC) with the giant pink tie banner; wayfinding post pointing to Student Life Centre; exterior stair under cantilever at right.

author: Gaelan D'costa
viewpoint_description: Close-up of a concrete pier and dark-framed glass entrance doors with wood kick panels and a black fascia canopy; chalk pink tie drawing. Building not named by uploader; very likely MC ground floor (Pink tie category).

author: JFVoll
viewpoint_description: DC glass barrel vault with teal duct elbows, red steel masts and canopy at an entrance, tan metal-banded low wing at left, grey interlocking paver plaza, concrete planters, bike racks, waste/recycling station. Most recent photo in set.

author: Kiyan
viewpoint_description: Panorama along a herringbone/running-bond grey-brown paver walkway toward DC: white metal-clad box framed by red portal beams, glass vault behind; tan banded 3-4 storey building on left with benches and picnic table; conifers at right; light snow.

author: Ben Babcock
viewpoint_description: Close-up of a DC entrance: red steel masts with diagonal tie-rods holding a flat canopy, red portal frames along a pale corrugated metal box, teal duct elbow, bikes parked against low wing, paver plaza.

author: wctaiwan
viewpoint_description: DC long side seen from across the railway tracks (east side, facing the ION/rail corridor and E5): three duct elbows over the vault, red masts and portal frames, pale metal box, street lamps, conifers, walkway.

author: Victor Vucicevich
viewpoint_description: DC entrance in sun: red cylindrical columns of portal frames at left, red masts with tie-rods and canopy, vault with duct elbows, tan two-level low wing with silver horizontal banding and curved corners at right, bike racks.

author: Victor Vucicevich
viewpoint_description: Elevated view from E5 4th floor over a service road: glazed pedestrian bridge on red steel posts, DC barrel vault and banded wing at right, QNC honeycomb cube and labs in the background.

author: S Woodside from Canada
viewpoint_description: Low-res phone photo from a Ring Road walkway looking at DC: vault, duct elbows, red portal frame, dense bike parking, purple-leaf trees; construction fencing in foreground; sign post with Semapedia tag.

author: Daniel Hsia
viewpoint_description: Night HDR-style view of a DC glazed two-storey section raised on red columns over a walkway, interior red and teal steel visible, bike racks, path lamps.

author: Justin Mathews from Waterloo, Canada
viewpoint_description: QNC honeycomb cube seen facing west from a paved plaza (east side): hexagonal steel frame over silver glass, rock garden boulders, round concrete planter edge, poster kiosk, lamp post, autumn trees.

author: Shipandreceive
viewpoint_description: QNC from the road at dusk: cantilevered glass bar with vertical fins at left, honeycomb cube at right, charcoal brick podium, louvred metal band, illuminated orange ground-floor glazing.

author: JustSomePics
viewpoint_description: QNC from Ring Road in summer: cantilevered finned glass bar, honeycomb cube, charcoal brick podium with green roof, louvre band, orange panel, SLC and QNC monument signs, SLC brick at left.

author: Jon
viewpoint_description: Infrared-processed image of QNC bar and cube with brick podium. Commons date (2005) is wrong; building completed 2012.

author: tubafil
viewpoint_description: Night long exposure looking up at the honeycomb frame, lit warm orange, star trails, bare tree branches.

author: Justin Mathews from Waterloo, Canada
viewpoint_description: Junction of MC (precast window hoods) and QNC (black ribbed metal box), connected by a glazed bridge with horizontal louvres; concrete round column.

author: Maria Ly from San Francisco, USA
viewpoint_description: QNC under construction: finned glass bar and partially clad honeycomb cube, grey brick podium, construction fencing.

author: Maria Ly from San Francisco, USA
viewpoint_description: QNC under construction seen from the road: bar on pilotis, cube framing, bus shelter, Aecon sign; brown-brick building at right (probably B2).

author: Victor Vucicevich
viewpoint_description: Upward view of QNC glass bar (vertical fins, dark soffit) and honeycomb cube above louvre band and two-tone grey brick podium.

author: Victor Vucicevich
viewpoint_description: QNC honeycomb cube viewed from MC side through trees in spring 2012 (before completion); timber pergola edge at bottom.

author: Giligone at English Wikipedia
viewpoint_description: Stitched panorama of the SLC crescent courtyard: curved 3-storey blue glass ribbon facade, buff brick end pavilions, timber pergolas on buff block piers, picnic tables, paver banding, central tree planter.

author: Daniel Hsia from Mississauga, Canada
viewpoint_description: SLC curved courtyard facade at night, interior lit; silhouette of courtyard tree.

author: Victor Vucicevich
viewpoint_description: SLC courtyard facade in 2012 (spring, bare tree): two curved glazing bands, grey corrugated metal block at upper left, pergolas, picnic tables, dark grey paver bands.

author: Gorillagripbusy
viewpoint_description: Pergola walkway beside SLC (east side, facing QNC): tapered buff block piers carrying timber slat roof, timber benches, red bench seat, bike rack, SLC glass/brick corner, QNC behind.

author: Sampsonchen
viewpoint_description: Bombshelter pub patio at the SLC at night (temporary ski-ramp event): brick wall, serving window, timber picnic tables, lights.

author: Dnllnd
viewpoint_description: Bronze/black Haldimand Tract land acknowledgement plaque on red-brown brick wall (category: Student Life Centre).

author: Giligone at English Wikipedia
viewpoint_description: Panorama from MC Green looking south: DC (left), MC, SLC, PAC (right); open lawn, young trees, spruces, concrete paths, parked service vehicles.

author: Victor Vucicevich
viewpoint_description: Curving asphalt path in the rock garden between MC and QNC: boulders (one with plaques), junipers/yews, pines, lamp post, timber pergola, buff brick building, MC pilotis beyond.

author: Justin Mathews from Waterloo, Canada
viewpoint_description: Bronze cracked-egg fountain sculpture in shallow pool beside a brown brick building. Flickr geotag 43.471744,-80.543478 (between MC and C2); location not otherwise confirmed.

author: gloom
viewpoint_description: Close-up of dry beech-like leaves on a shrub in the Math & Computer rock garden (plant reference only).

author: Robert Elder
viewpoint_description: Heavy timber pergola with wisteria vines over cracked concrete slabs, stone column fragments, timber benches; concrete building on pilotis behind (probably MC). Location inferred, not stated.

author: Robert Elder
viewpoint_description: Gravel/asphalt path to a round poster kiosk with circular timber bench and benches, under mature trees; building with pilotis beyond. Same kiosk type as in QNC_honeycomb photo; location inferred.
